name: Crowded-short funding capitulation squeeze (4h long the multi-session crowd)
rationale: MECHANISM (H3 on 4h — the funding-clock cadence): funding accrues on a multi-hour schedule, so a 4h bar reads the crowded-short extreme on the same clock the carry actually bleeds, catching the deeper, more persistent negative-funding regimes (the 46-day Apr-2026 streak). The counterparty is the crowded short whose carry bleed forces an eventual cover; the cross_down is capitulation-in-progress. Long spot with funding accruing to the position (we receive nothing but pay nothing while funding is negative). Entry: funding_rate cross_down through a negative floor AND ret_Nd above a knife-guard (price stopped falling) AND vol_realized below a ceiling (orderly, not a crash) AND open_interest above a rising floor (shorts still ADDING — the more squeezable config). DISCONFIRMER: swap the cross for a static funding-LEVEL lt — equal performance means the event adds nothing over the decayed carry-harvest; drop the OI-rising arm — no degradation means the crowding read is cosmetic. Must clear fees net.
catalyst: 4h funding cross_down into a persistent crowded-short regime, price basing, OI rising
